title: 26 CFR 1.6081-2, Automatic extension of time to file certain returns filed by partnerships (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: How long is the extension if Form 7004 was filed by September 15, 2026?
passages.excerpt: for any taxable year will be allowed an automatic six-month extension of time to file the return after the date prescribed for filing the return if the partnership files an application under this section in accordance with paragraph (b) of this section.
